title: Getting Started with Tempo.Blazor.Reporting
overview: Tempo.Blazor.Reporting provides Blazor components and services for viewing, exploring, designing, and embedding Tempo reports. It supports embedded rendering with local report definitions and remote rendering against Tempo Report Server endpoints.

programCs.description: Register Tempo.Blazor and reporting viewer services.

cssAndJs.description: The package uses Tempo.Blazor styles and ships a reporting viewer JS bundle as a static web asset.
cssAndJs.code:
<link href="_content/Tempo.Blazor/css/tempo-blazor.bundled.css" rel="stylesheet" />
<!-- The report viewer loads _content/Tempo.Blazor.Reporting/js/reporting/tm-report-viewer.bundle.js as an ES module. -->

importsRazor.description: Add reporting namespaces for convenient component usage.

notes: EmbeddedReportSource runs the reporting engine in the current Blazor render mode.
RemoteReportSource uses HTTP endpoints compatible with the report viewer-facing remote API shape.
For full Report Server catalog, revisions, render jobs, and data source administration use ITempoReportServerClient from Tempo.Reporting.Abstractions.
